title: Chest CT

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.text: This synthetic policy identifies information used to prepare a service request for human review.

sections.heading: Coverage Criteria
sections.text:
- The request states the diagnostic question the CT is intended to address.
- Relevant prior imaging or clinical findings are identified.
- The requested study and use of contrast are clinically explained.

sections.heading: Required Documentation
sections.text:
- Relevant symptoms and duration
- Prior chest imaging findings
- Known risk factors and relevant medical history
- Reason for contrast or non-contrast study
- Requested follow-up interval when applicable

sections.heading: Limitations and Exceptions
sections.text:
- An abnormal prior study should be described rather than merely referenced.
- Screening and diagnostic requests may follow different review paths.
- Final review remains a human responsibility.

sections.heading: Decision Boundary
sections.text: Meeting the listed criteria does not automatically approve the request. Eligibility, benefits, exclusions, clinical context and applicable requirements must be reviewed by an authorized human reviewer.

disclaimer: Synthetic policy created for software demonstration and evaluation. It is not medical or insurance guidance.
